第二十四章 第一个觉醒异能的幸存者-《末世入侵：我在副本里面当NPC》

上一章

存书签

下一章

爻雪所说的并没有欺骗这些人，秘境被分为0到5级一共六个级别，其中0级是最安全的，里面几乎不会遇到什么危险，但0级秘境可遇不可求，根据系统告诉她的资料，秘境出现最低也是1级秘境，因为0级秘境的波动十分的微弱，几乎不可探查。

等到能够探查了，0级秘境早就成为1级秘境了，而1级秘境和0级秘境可是没有一点可比性的。

还有一点就是，0级秘境所谓的几乎不会遇到什么危险，这里指的是里面的生物主动攻击进入秘境者，并不包括环境。

0级秘境中的环境并不是固定的，可能是高山绿水、绿树成荫，也有可能是戈壁沙滩、恶臭沼泽，或者直接是一片海洋。

这些都是爻雪从系统给的资料里面看到的，根据不同的环境，里面孕育出的生物也各不相同。

在看到这些资料的时候，爻雪无比庆幸自己当初的谨慎。

当时她的第一反应也是里面是一片森林。

在听到爻雪的话之后，苏辰率先问道：“店长，我的异能觉醒药剂好了吗？”

闻言，爻雪点了点头说道：“已经好了，你们决定好谁用了吗？另外，如果觉醒出火雷这种元素类的异能，刚开始的时候很可能会因为控制不住而对周围的事物造成伤害，所以我建议你们到一个空旷的地方觉醒，或者是…”

爻雪指了指地面，说道：“直接在这里觉醒。”

毕竟这可是她第一次制作出异能觉醒药剂，算是自己的第一份试验品，虽然她对自己很有信心，但是……

而且她自己当时觉醒异能的时候并没有太大的感觉，所以她想看看其他人是不是也是一点反应都没有。

听到爻雪这样说，苏辰说道：“那就劳烦店长了。”

What Yaoxue said did not deceive these people. The secret realm is divided into six levels from 0 to 5. Level 0 is the safest, and there is almost no danger inside. However, the level 0 secret realm can be encountered but cannot be found. According to the information the system told her, the lowest level of the secret realm is a level 1 secret realm, because the fluctuations in the level 0 secret realm are very weak and almost undetectable.

By the time it can be explored, the level 0 secret realm has long since become the level 1 secret realm, and there is no comparison between the level 1 secret realm and the level 0 secret realm.

Another point is that there is almost no danger in the level 0 secret realm. This refers to the creatures inside actively attacking those who enter the secret realm, not including the environment.

The environment in the level 0 secret realm is not fixed. It may be mountains, green waters, and green trees, or it may be Gobi beaches, stinky swamps, or directly an ocean.

These are what Yaoxue saw from the information provided by the system. According to different environments, the creatures bred in them are also different.

When seeing this information, Yaoxue was extremely grateful for her caution.

Her first reaction at that time was that it was a forest inside.

After hearing Yao Xue's words, Su Chen took the lead and asked: "Store manager, is my power awakening potion ready?"

Hearing this, Yaoxue nodded and said: "It's done. Have you decided who will use it? In addition, if you awaken elemental powers such as fire and thunder, you may be unable to control them at the beginning and cause damage to the surrounding things, so I suggest that you awaken in an open place, or..."

Yaoxue pointed to the ground and said: "Awaken directly here."

After all, this was her first time making a power awakening potion, and it was considered her first test product. Although she was very confident in herself, but...

And she didn't feel much when she awakened her powers, so she wanted to see if others didn't react at all.

Hearing what Yaoxue said, Su Chen said, "Then I'll bother the store manager."
